name: Subtle Effects (Forge) 1.20.1-1.15.0
changelog:
## As of this update, 1.20.1 is being put into maintenance mode, meaning it will no longer receive content updates, only bug fixes as needed. Additionally, support for 26.2 is being dropped. 26.1 will still be supported for now, though only on 26.1.2.


### Additions
- Added bone particles to skeletons and skeleton horses being attacked. Each skeleton variant has custom bone textures to match its variant
- Naming a parrot "party parrot" or "jeb_" will cause it to continuously change texture while dancing. [Just like Mojang intended](https://minecraft.wiki/w/File:Dancing_Parrot_JE1.gif#/media/File:Dancing_Parrot_JE1.gif)
- Added volume config for chests opening randomly underwater
- Added allay twinkling sounds (Allays will randomly play amethyst sounds)
- Added allay duplication sounds
- Added blue electricity particles around charged creepers. When a charged creeper explodes, the explosion will also have the particles mixed in ([#226](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/226))
- Replaced the vanilla electricity particles
- Added electricity particles in the air around a small area when lightning strikes
- Added endman particles for when a shukler teleports. Mojang has since added them to vanilla in 26.3 :)
- Added redstone dust particles around the redstone torches of powered comparators
- Added redstone dust particles around powered activator/powered/detector rails
- Added smoke particles occasionally appearing around magma blocks
- Added steam and sounds when a player with frost walker stands on magma blocks
- Added a custom debug screen, fully independent of the vanilla debug screen. Replaces my original particle count command and shows some ticker info. Still toggled through commands
- Added particles that rise up when an item is enchanted at an enchantment table. Comes in 2 styles: glyphs (default), looks like vanilla enchant particles using SGA characters, and magic, similar to trial spawner activation particles, but purple
- Replaced tipped arrow particles with potion poof clouds
- Added config to disable splashes in waterlogged blocks ([#235](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/235))
- Added a spawn texture animation to heart particles
- Added a splash height scale config

### Changes
- Snoring particles now have alpha fade out
- Tweaked splash scaling again.
- Renamed vanilla enchantment particle ralated configs
- The behavior for end crystal magic particles has been completely reworked and will now slowly orbit the end crystal clockwise
- When an end crystal is sitting in fire, the fire block will no longer spawn particles
- Grouped allay and vex configs
- Updated particle bounding box renderer
- Added a few vanilla particles to the particle culling blocklist
- Changed potion rings to move down for harmful effects
- Made potion rings emissive (they glow now)
- Grouped potion cloud configs
- Improved how slime trails and projectile splat particles detect blocks
- Retextured egg splat particle
- [26.x] Changed explosion splashes to work client side only again
- Tweaked the movement of the mushroom spore particles that spawn on mushroom islands
- Einstein solar system now changes the number of heads rendered based on health percentage
- __**Technical Changes**__
 - If installed on the server, attack based effects will now be visible to other players, e.g., chicken feathers, skeleton bones, etc. Additionally, this allows them to work for a wider range of damage types, e.g., arrows, falling dripstone, etc. Because of these changes, the configs have been moved back into a separate config section inside entity configs.
 - Rewrote much of how entity tickers work
 - Replaced my custom multiloader networking api with the Fzzy Config networking api
 - Rewrote particle registration, now uses the Fzzy Config registration api and particles are now also registered on the server
 - Rewrote the biome particles system
 - Rewrote dynamic sprite set loading
 - Rewrote/Improved splashes for remote players (other players on the server)

### Fixes
- Fixed splashes being able to be spawned inside water streams
- Fixed ender chests not spawning bubbles underwater
- Fixed double chests creating an unnecessary ticker
- Fixed ClassCastException for farmland ([#230](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/230))
- Fixed loaded Burning Effects for Dyed Flames persisting after resource reload
- Fixed fireflies only spawning in habitat biomes by default
- Fixed ClassCastException related to entities being cast to client players ([#250](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/250))
- Fixed game crashing with End Remastered ([#258](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/258))
- Fixed crash with custom splashes missing textures (specifically lava splashes), if textures can't be found, the Missing Texture texture will be used instead ([#219](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/219), [#237](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/237), [#242](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/242))
- Fixed Sodium causing rendering issues with bubbles when the Biome Color Water Particles pack is enabled
- Fixed the pack format version for the Biome Color Water Particles pack being incorrect in 1.21.1 and 26.1
- [26.x] Fixed the `Splash Effects` toggle config not applying to explosion splashes (#239)
- [26.x] Fixed lava splashes not spawning
- [26.x] Fixed splashes crashing on NeoForge ([#255](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/255), [#259](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/259))
- [26.x] Fixed missing mod icon on NeoForge
- [26.x] Fixed Einstein solar system rendering all armor pieces
- [26.x] Fixed mod icon/banner for NeoForge's redesigned mod list screen
- [26.3] Fixed log stripping using the wrong block particles
- [26.3] Fixed mooshroom feeding particle changes potentially not working
- [26.3] Fixed custom copper scrapping particles not spawning

name: Subtle Effects (Forge) 1.20.1-1.14.0
changelog:
### Additions
- Added poof effects and an egg crack sound when using a spawn egg.
- Added powdered snow block place sounds when using a bucket of powdered snow.
- Added sparks to when a magma cube lands on the ground.
- Added sparks and sounds to monster spawners.

### Changes
- Changed snow golem step sounds to be snow sounds rather than being based on the block they are standing on.
- Updated Korean translation (Thanks [bin0213](https://www.curseforge.com/members/bin0213))
- Made Prometheus and Dyed Flames support resource driven. Allowing resource packs to customize the entity burning effects for custom fire types.
- Changed how Spark Providers handle colors. If you're using the 'default' or 'soul' color presets, those will no longer work. I will be updating the wiki soon.
- Splashes have nearly been completely rewritten, allowing for resource driven textures and colors.
- Bucket interaction particle colors are now resource driven.
- Changed monster spawner particles to be a purple-ish color based on the eyes in the block texture. This feature is disabled by default, if this is something that people really like, it may become enabled by default in the future.
- Updated the mod's birthday notification chat message.
- Tweaked how item rarity particles determine their color. ([#193](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/193)) (Thanks [Artyrian](https://github.com/TheArtyrian))

### Fixes
- (1.21.1) Fixed minecarts not spawning splashes (can't be fixed for 1.20.1).
- Fixed the Particle Effects mod overriding lingering potion effects rather than working with Subtle Effects. ([#209](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/209))
- (1.20.1) Possibly fixed the sleeping sounds crash on Forge. ([#208](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/208))
- Fixed all water effects not properly getting biome water colors, causing biome blending colors and resource pack modified colors to be ignored.
- Fixed splashes sometimes scaling to absurdly large sizes. ([#200](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/200))
- (1.20.1) Fixed Earthen Clay blocks from Immersive Weathering making a lot of drip splashing sounds when directly over water ([#183](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/183))
- (1.20.1) Possible fix for [#146](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/146) again
- (1.20.1) Fixed splash particles not rendering with shaders ([#196](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/196))
- (1.20.1) Fixed Forge crash with Optifine. Please note that Optifine issues will have little to no support. ([#190](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/190))
- (1.21.11) Fixed crash with Dyed Flames. ([#185](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/185))
- Fixed the splash effects from Particular causing the game to crash ([#168](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/168))

name: Subtle Effects (Forge) 1.20.1-1.13.1
changelog:
The 1.21.10 port is in progress, please be patient. Particle rendering was completely rewritten, so much of the mod needs to be changed in order to work

### Added
- Added a notification chat message about party hats during the mod's birthday
- Explosions now cause splashes when under lava/water, size is based on explosion size and distance from the fluid surface
- Added a config to change the lifetime of fallen leaves
- Added scale and alpha configs for potion rings
- Added spawnable blocks configs for geysers (this can also apply to fluids, so you can have flame geysers spawn on lava, similar to Dynamic Surroundings)
- Added armadillo brushing particles
- Added a particle culling blocklist config
- Reworked fire overlay configs

### Changes
- Chest bubbles work for modded chests now
- Tweaked large waterfalls to work on diagonals and particle spawning
- Changed how waterfalls determine open sides. Fixes ([#156](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/156), [#152](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/152))
- Tweaked the velocity of droplets spawned from splashes
- Improved blended particle render type. Fixes ([#151](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/151))
- Increased leaf particle spawn chances and movement speed during rain

### Fixes
- Fixed `improvedVillagerSweatingEffects` config not being used
- Fixed Lithium blocking random underwater chest animations. Fixes ([#148](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/148))
- Fixed splashes not working in cauldrons
- Fixed player splashes not being visible to other players
- Fixed falling blocks not spawning splashes
- Fixed primed TNT not spawning splashes
- Fixed lingering potion clouds being colored wrong

name: Subtle Effects (Forge) 1.20.1-1.13.0
changelog:
Today (October 4th) is the mod's 1st birthday! And in celebration, you all get party hats! Thank you all for downloading, supporting, and enjoying the mod over the last year!

### Additions
- Added eat sounds and particles to cakes. Should be compatible with most modded cakes, including Farmer's Delight pies
- Added ripples particles to rain and water/lava drops landing on water/lava (Yes, I know this goes against the suggestion guidelines in the FAQ)
- Added 3D splash effects for entities falling in water/lava
- Added bubbles to entity poof effects (mob death clouds/mob spawner spawn clouds) underwater
- Added waterfalls. Comes in 3 different sizes, each size can be individually disabled. Requires water streams to have at least 1 water source block underneath and 1 additional water block next to the first
  - Small: A small stream of droplet particles moving in the direction of the current, emitted from the base of the water stream
  - Medium: Cloud like particles called water fall clouds, spawning from the base of the water stream and moving out, similar to cascades in other mods. Requires at least a 6 block vertical water stream
  - Large: Increased number of water fall clouds with a larger spawning area, along with large mist clouds. Requires at least a 3x10 block vertical water stream 
- Added bubbles to breaking blocks underwater
- Added bubbles to chests while open underwater
  - Chests will also sometimes open randomly to spawn bubbles when underwater
- Added bubbles to opening a barrel underwater
- Added a continuous stream of bubbles spawning from the mouth of decorated pots when underwater
- Added bucket use effects to:
  - Water bottles when converting blocks to mud
  - Picking up water with a glass bottle
- Added bubbles to the dust effects from dispensers/droppers/crafter when firing out items underwater
- Added party hats in celebration of the mod's first birthday! If you're a party pooper, you can turn it off with the `Enable Easter Eggs` config in the `General` config section

### Changes
- Changed ominous vault connection particles to be more accurate
- Renamed `Drop Land In Fluid Splashes` config to `Drop Land In Fluid Ripples`, since drops now spawn ripples instead of splashes
- Vanilla leaf particles now land on the ground and fade out rather than disappearing into the ground. Additionally, they can also land on water and cause a ripple effect (Applies to cherry leaves, not just the leaves in 1.21.5+)
- Falling block fall effects now spawn bubbles instead of dust underwater
- Tweaked blended render type, hopefully will fix some issues
- Changed bucket use effects to spawn droplets instead of vanilla splashes
- Changed wolf shake/villager sweating effects to droplets
- Made structure voids work like barriers. If the item is in hand, the surrounding blocks will be visible

### Fixes
- Fixed potion rings not being visible to other players
- Fixed frosty breath/drowning bubbles spawning while using a spyglass in first person
- Fixed dispensers not spawning bucket use/sheep shearing effects
- Fixed bucket use effects be able to be spawned underwater
- Fixed lava cauldrons spawning sparks when underwater
- Fixed Einstein Solar System rendering all armor pieces instead of just helmets

name: Subtle Effects (Forge) 1.20.1-1.12.1
changelog:
- Fixed fireflies spawning underground in habitat biomes
- Added support for the Particle Effects mod to potion clouds ([#131](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/131))
- Tweaked the velocity at which sparks spawn from minecarts

name: Subtle Effects (Forge) 1.20.1-1.12.0
changelog:
Many configs have been changed in this version, and as a result, many of them will be reset. Please make sure you read the change log to know what configs need to be reconfigured

Also, I'm dropping support for 1.21.5, so this will be the last release for that version

### Additions
- Added sounds for moving through cobwebs
- Added a config to disable rendering fire on screen when you have the fire resistance effect
- Added block list configs for redstone, glowstone, and amethyst block effects, so the effects can be applied to other blocks. Your chiseled glowstone and amythest bricks can now look just as cool as the vanilla variants, yay.
- Added smoke geyers. Spawns in the nether like flame geysers and spouts smoke
- Added bubble geyers. Spawns underwater and spouts a thin column of bubbles (Suggested in [#115](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/115))
- Added falling dust particles to fallable blocks when sitting on weak support blocks, e.g., sand on iron bars
- Added a density config for end portal frame particles
- Added an ambient spark-like dot particle effect to brewing stands
- Added an alpha config for vanilla potion-related particles, e.g., potion swirls
- Added an alpha config to change the transparency of potion-related particles near the player's face. This is to help make them less intrusive when a potion effect is active
- Added item break particles for feeding an animal
- Added sounds to feeding animals
- Added a density config for lava sparks
- Added a density config for command block particles
- [1.21.5+] Added a config to replace firefly bush particles with the custom ones
- [1.21.5+] Added dead leaf particles around a mob's feet when walking over leaf litter
- Added potion clouds. Replaces the vanilla potion swirls that lingering potions emit and the dragon's breath particles that the dragon's breath clouds emit
- Added potion poof clouds. Replaces the vanilla potion swirls that splash potions emit when they collide with something

### Changes
- Replaced the smoke particle spawned by rain falling on heated blocks with steam
- Added lava cauldrons to the list of heated blocks that cause rain to steam
- Sheep fluff particles will now cycle through colors if the sheared sheep is a Jeb sheep
- The `Glowstone Block Dust Display Type` config has been replaced with two separate boolean configs, one for if the effects are enabled and one for if they should be forced to only spawn in the nether
- Grouped amethyst block effect configs
- Moved the item rarity particle configs to the `Items` config category
- Moved thorwable projectile configs to the `Items` config category
- Grouped axe configs
- The `Entities/Attacked` config section has been replaced with a config group
- Replaced the `Drop Land Sounds` toggle config with a volume config
- The `Falling Dust`, `Falling Dust Start Distance`, `Land Dust`, and `Land Sound` configs in the `Blocks/Falling Blocks` section have been renamed
- Renamed `Lava Sparks` config to `Lava Sparks Display Type`
- Flame geyser configs have been moved to a dedicated geyser config section inside the `Environment` category
- Flame geysers now have some smoke particles mixed in with the flame particles
- Flame geysers are now enabled by default
- Firefly spawning and configs have been completely rewritten. Highlights of the rewrite are shown  below
  - The default fireflies can now be replaced with vanilla's Spring to Life drop fireflies in the configs. This is not exclusive to 1.21.5+
  - With the configs rewrite, you now have much more control over where fireflies can and can't spawn and how many are spawned
  - All firefly configs are now in the `Environment/Fireflies` config section
  - There is now a dimension block list config to prevent fireflies from spawning in certain dimensions
  - Fireflies will now spawn in lush caves and do not depend on nighttime to do so
  - Fireflies now have support with Serene Seasons and, by default, will stop spawning in late autumn and start again in early spring (Suggested in [#123](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/123))
  - The buzzing sounds that firefly bushes play will now play when fireflies are out at night. This is not exclusive to 1.21.5+
- Armor will now render on the Einstein Solar System
- Improvements to the dust particles from falling blocks landing on the ground
- Renamed the `Force White Enchantment Particles` config to `Disable Randomized Shading`
- Reworked vanilla's particles for feeding flowers to a brown mooshroom (yes, I actually spent time rewriting the effects for a mechanic nobody remembers exists)
- Reworked vanilla's particles for shearing a mooshroom
- Replaced the smoke particles emitted by blazes with campfire style particles
- Replaced the render type for vanilla potion-related particles. This is so they work better with potion clouds (This could cause some rendering issues. If it does, the config is called `Replace Spell Particle Render Type` in the `General` config category)
- Changed the render type for ender eye placement rings and slime trails
- Updated Simplified Chinese translation (Thanks [OutlinedArc217](https://github.com/OutlinedArc217))
- Updated Traditional Chinese translation (Thanks [OutlinedArc217](https://github.com/OutlinedArc217))
- Updated Literal Chinese translation (Thanks [OutlinedArc217](https://github.com/OutlinedArc217))

### Fixes
- Fixed particle rain overriding lava splash textures ([#111](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/111))
- Fixed angry villager particles turning into heart pop particles
- [1.20.1] Fixed crash with origins when leaving water as the Merlin origin ([#118](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/118))
- Fixed NeoForge crashing with End Remastered installed ([#113](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/113), [#122](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/122))
- Fixed a vanilla bug that prevents animals in love/breeding mode from spawning heart particles continually (this has been a bug for so long I didn't even know it used to be a feature)
- [1.21.5+] Fixed falling blocks not spawning dust while falling

name: Subtle Effects (Forge) 1.20.1-1.10.0
changelog:
### Added
- Added Traditional Chinese (Thanks [OutlinedArc217](https://github.com/OutlinedArc217))
- Added Literal Chinese (Thanks [OutlinedArc217](https://github.com/OutlinedArc217))
- Added egg splat particle. Spawned when a thrown egg hits a block, if the egg didn't spawn a chicken
- Added ender eye place effects. When an ender eye is placed in a portal frame, a ring will appear around the eye and glow for a few seconds. Ring color can be changed in the config and is compatible with End Remastered
- Added an option to the `/subtle_effects` command to toggle displaying particle count, this is a debugging feature and not meant to be always enabled
- Applied the flint and steel use effects to fire charges
- Added a poof of dust around the bottom of a falling block when it hits the ground
- Replaced axe scraping and wax off particles with block destroy particles
- Added anvil use effects to smithing tables
- Added lava/water drip splash particles when a drop lands
- Added Einstein solar system. If you know, you know
- Added a config to disable frosty breath and drowning bubbles in creative mode
- Added a config to force drowning bubbles into a single continual stream
- Added item destroy effects when an item is composted
- Replaced ominous vault connection particles with blue ones
- Added an environment config section. As a result, biome configs have been moved into a subsection and will be reset
- Added flame geysers. An occasional 5 block tall spray of fire into the air, lasting for a few seconds before stopping. Can spawn from netherrack, blackstone, and soul soil. Disabled by default, as I want to get some feedback on stability before making it enabled by default
- (1.21.5) Added feather particle variants for the new chicken variants

### Changed
- Updated Japanese (Thanks [KAGUYA-1137](https://github.com/KAGUYA-1137))
- Updated Russian ([Thanks Det-rovv](https://github.com/Det-rovv))
- Falling block configs have been moved to a separate config subsection within `Blocks`. Meaning all falling block configs will be reset
- Added suspicious sand and gravel to the list of falling blocks
- Tweaked default falling block dust density
- Grouped glowstone and redstone block configs. Configs will not be reset
- Removed `Cull Particles With No Alpha` config as it was causing more problems than it was worth
- Night vision no longer flashes when it is running out, instead, it will fade out
- Anvil use effects will now play 3 times roughly in sync with the sound
- Many entity related effects will now check if the entity is visible before displaying
- Increased the number of particles spawned when an item breaks, e.g., tools, weapons, armor
- (1.21.5) Open eye blossoms will continually spawn particles

### Fixed
- Fixed crash from mods that add different grindstones, e.g., Create Enchantment Industry ([#90](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/90))
- Fixed torch flower particles not being offset with the block offset
- Fixed crash with Cozy Homes (Thanks [BluSpring](https://github.com/BluSpring))
- Fixed `Drowning Bubbles Density` config working backwards
- Fixed frosty breath appearing in the nether with Serene Seasons installed

name: Subtle Effects (Forge) 1.20.1-1.9.4-hotfix.1

name: Subtle Effects (Fabric) 1.20.1-1.9.4

- Fixed potion rings appearing for empty potions (like water bottles)

name: Subtle Effects (Forge) 1.20.1-1.9.3

We recently reached 1 million downloads on CurseForge and 200 thousand on Modrinth! Thank you all for supporting and downloading the mod! Also thank you to everyone who has reported the big issues with the Forge 1.20.1 version

name: Subtle Effects (Forge) 1.20.1-1.9.2
changelog:

- [Forge 1.20.1] Fixed items not working correctly on servers ([#70](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/70))

name: Subtle Effects (Forge) 1.20.1-1.9.1
changelog:
Note: Despite the networking changes in this release Forge 1.20.1 is still not fully client sided, however, progress has been made and may be fixed in the next update or so

**Additions**
- Added a snowflake effect for freezing mobs/players
- Added wiki link to ModMenu menu

**Changes**
- The particle and sound registries are no longer synced from server to client. This should allow all clients to join a server with the mod installed whether the client has the mod or not. There is a server config to disable this functionality in case something breaks
- NeoForge now properly checks if the packet channel exists on the client before sending packets
- Particles using the 'custom' render type are no longer culled. This specifically is to fix the elder guardian effect being culled when it shouldn't
- Improvements to sparks spawning around lava
- Lava cauldrons now play ambient sounds and pop vanilla lava sparks
- Replaced the powder snow snowflakes
- Improvements to thrown egg sounds
   - Config is now a volume slider rather than a toggle
   - The pitch is now somewhat randomized

**Fixes**
- Fixed item rarity particles crash with Item Borders support (#64)
- Fixed drowning bubbles spawning too much (#65)
- Fixed composter particles sometimes crashing with other mods (#66)
- Fixed entity effects not being affected if the tick rate is frozen (#67)
- Fixed mob skull shaders sometimes not applying correctly
- Fixed vanilla XP bottle effects not appearing for clients without the mod installed on servers with the mod

name: Subtle Effects (Forge) 1.20.1-1.9.0
changelog:
- Many configs have been added to collapsable config groups (This won't reset modified configs)
- Added config to disable chicken egg smash sound
- Changed `count` field in Spark Providers to be an [Int Provider](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Configured_feature/int_provider)
- Added a `chance` field to Spark Providers. The chance that particles will be spawned during a random game tick
- The 'color' field in Spark Providers now accepts an array of 3 floats as well as integers
- Improved loading and error handling of spark providers
- Fixed biome particle configs not being applied until after game restart ([#52](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/52))
- Updated Japanese translation ([#53](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/53))
- Added a heart pop particle that appears as soon as a heart particle disappears
- Added bubble popping. Makes use of the vanilla bubble pop particle and sound
- The white shine on bubbles is now slightly tinted to match the water color
- Fixed bubbles causing severe lag (specifically when using the Biome Color Water Particles pack)
- Frosty breath and drowning bubbles now appear in creative mode
- Added a config to completely disable particle culling ([#57](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/57))
- Removed the `campfireSizzlingSounds` config as it was redundant. To disable it set the volume config to 0
- Fixed entity burning effects (flames, sparks, hissing sounds) not working for some entities (like projectiles)
- Added a steam effect for when burning entities are extinguished by water
- Fixed item rarity particles appearing black for items using a custom rarity, for example, rarities added with KubeJS ([#43](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/43))
- If Item Borders is installed, item rarity particles will attempt to get the item's border colors, if unable to get the item's display name colors
- Fixed configs in the `Entities/Explosives` category not being translated
- Mob skull shaders are now enabled by default
- Mob skull shaders are now resource driven, allowing them to be added to any head equipable item. [Wiki page](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/wiki/Mob-Skull-Shaders)
- Added potion rings. A brief effect that displays around players and some mobs that just drank a potion, very much inspired by MC Dungeons
- The maximum value for the `xpBottleParticlesDensity` config has been significantly increased
- Changed the default value for the `fireHeight` config to be -0.15. Making fire rending a little lower
- The chance for an azalea petal/flower particle to use a sprite with leaves has been decreased. 
- Changed the iron golem crack particles to look like the iron golem texture
- Increased the size of snow particles (This applies to snowball trails and snow golems taking damage)
- Increased the default density for snowball trails
- Lava drip particles now glow
- Drip particles now play a sound when landing on the ground and a different sound when landing in a fluid, this also includes filled cauldrons
- Drip particles will now evaporate into steam when landing in a fluid of the opposite type, e.g lava falling into water or water falling into lava
- The `Blocks/Updated Smoke/Lava Spark Smoke` config has been moved to the `General` config category (this config will be reset)
- Fixed dust clouds caused by maces spawning on the incorrect player, as well as added a config specifically for them
- Added a config for dust clouds spawned from flying into a wall with elytra
- Replaced the slimeball particles for the oozing potion effect with slime block particles
- Fixed fire and furnace sparks always flying to the south-east instead of being randomized
- The `Entities/Explosives/TNT Flames` config has been changed to a density config
- Minecart sparks have been reworked. They are now a continuous effect rather than only happening when landing rails. Theres also a config to revert this
- Added a config for minecart sparks density
- Added a density config for beacon particles
- Added a speed config for beacon particles
- Added an alpha (transparency) config for drowning bubbles
- Improved pollen particle movement
- Added a config to prevent dust clouds from rendering within about a 2 block radius of the player. Hopefully this will make them less intrusive for players that want that

name: Subtle Effects (Forge) 1.20.1-1.8.0
changelog:
- Added Spark Providers. A resource pack driven system for customizing spark color and behavior for blocks. As a result, the mod will now only spawn sparks for vanilla blocks, modded blocks will have to be added with a resource pack. Documentation for adding Spark Providers can be found on the wiki [here](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/wiki/Spark_Providers)
- Added a list config to add additional biomes for frosty breath to spawn in
- Particles are now culled in unloaded chunks (With config to disable)
- Added entity burning particle support for Soul Fire'd
- Added a pitched up turtle egg break sound when normal eggs are thrown
- Added a config to change the height position of the on screen fire overlay
- Added a config to change how far a falling block needs to fall before it spawns dust
- Beacon particle spawning has been tweaked slightly
- Fixed the 'Not Common' item rarity display option not working when 'Particle Color' was set to 'Name Color'([#42](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/42))
- Fixed overriding Visuality attack particles in 1.21.3 ([#47](https://github.com/MincraftEinstein/SubtleEffects/issues/47))
